caseName: Skaneateles Paper Co. v. City of Syracuse
caseNameFull: The Skaneateles Paper Company, in Error v. The City of Syracuse
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of New York.
attorneys: Mr. Martin Conboy, Mr. John W. Griggs, Mr. Arthur J. Baldwin and Mr. Charles W. Tooke for plaintiffs in error. ■, Mr. Charles L. Stone and Mr. Walter W. Magee for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Chicago &c. Railway Company v. McGuire, 196 U. S. 128; Scudder v. Comptroller of New York, 175 U. S. 32; Eastern Building &c. Association v. Welling, 181 U. S. 47.
